meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 DeepSpot-M 从 H&E 病理组织小图预测空间基因表达:按名称查约 1.9 万个蛋白编码基因,逐个小图给出该基因的表达量(log1p-CPM),再按原网格拼成整张切片的表达图。
howto.when: 当用户需要约 20x 的 224×224 H&E 图块的空间基因表达(log1p-CPM),要按基因名而非固定面板查询蛋白编码基因,或想在 histolab 切块后做整张切片预测时,会触发该技能。

say.text: 用 scgpt 基因嵌入,重新预测这张切片里 BRCA1 的表达。
say.note: 会换成 scgpt 来源的基因表示,重新输出该基因预测值。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses DeepSpot-M to predict spatial gene expression from 224x224 H&E tiles. Query genes by name (~19k); each tile returns log1p-CPM values, and outputs are laid out on the source grid as a slide-level map.
howto.when_en: Use when you need spatial expression (log1p-CPM) for 224x224 tiles at ~20x, want genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want whole-slide prediction after histolab tiling.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D in this 224x224 H&E tile with DeepSpot-M.
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM predictions for both genes on this tile.

say_en.text: Tile this whole slide with histolab at 224x224, then predict CD3D expression.
say_en.note: Returns a slide-level CD3D prediction map.

say_en.text: Re-run BRCA1 prediction on this slide using the scgpt gene embedding.
say_en.note: Uses the scgpt source and returns new BRCA1 values.
